_provenance.title: National curriculum in England: physical education programmes of study
_provenance.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
_provenance.scope: Statutory programme-of-study statements only (the 'Pupils should be taught' lists), verbatim. Non-statutory notes and guidance, aims, purpose of study and appendices are not included.

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: master basic movements including running, jumping, throwing and catching, as well as developing balance, agility and co-ordination, and begin to apply these in a range of activities

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: participate in team games, developing simple tactics for attacking and defending

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: perform dances using simple movement patterns

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: use running, jumping, throwing and catching in isolation and in combination

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: play competitive games, modified where appropriate [for example, badminton, basketball, cricket, football, hockey, netball, rounders and tennis], and apply basic principles suitable for attacking and defending

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: develop flexibility, strength, technique, control and balance [for example, through athletics and gymnastics]

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: perform dances using a range of movement patterns

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: take part in outdoor and adventurous activity challenges both individually and within a team

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: compare their performances with previous ones and demonstrate improvement to achieve their personal best

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: swim competently, confidently and proficiently over a distance of at least 25 metres

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: use a range of strokes effectively [for example, front crawl, backstroke and breaststroke]

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: perform safe self-rescue in different water-based situations

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: use a range of tactics and strategies to overcome opponents in direct competition through team and individual games [for example, badminton, basketball, cricket, football, hockey, netball, rounders, rugby and tennis]

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: develop their technique and improve their performance in other competitive sports [for example, athletics and gymnastics]

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: perform dances using advanced dance techniques in a range of dance styles and forms

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: take part in outdoor and adventurous activities which present intellectual and physical challenges and be encouraged to work in a team, building on trust and developing skills to solve problems, either individually or as a group

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: analyse their performances compared to previous ones and demonstrate improvement to achieve their personal best

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: take part in competitive sports and activities outside school through community links or sports clubs

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: use and develop a variety of tactics and strategies to overcome opponents in team and individual games [for example, badminton, basketball, cricket, football, hockey, netball, rounders, rugby and tennis]

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: develop their technique and improve their performance in other competitive sports [for example, athletics and gymnastics] or other physical activities [for example, dance]

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: take part in further outdoor and adventurous activities in a range of environments which present intellectual and physical challenges and which encourage pupils to work in a team, building on trust and developing skills to solve problems, either individually or as a group

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: evaluate their performances compared to previous ones and demonstrate improvement across a range of physical activities to achieve their personal best

statements.subject: physical education
statements.text: continue to take part regularly in competitive sports and activities outside school through community links or sports clubs
